quotes.text: Whatever the daemon enforces (limits, stall recovery, retry, hygiene) must apply to any workflow's steps (docs/bring-your-own-agent.md, docs/examples/byo/), not only ship-change, plan-bug and bugfix. A done point should show a BYO workflow run end to end under the daemon.

fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner). Research of the code for change set 01M7NVN: no test runs a bring-your-own workflow end to end under the daemon. Closest templates: cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/bugfix-workflow-autonomous.txtar (daemon --once with RHIZA_TEST_DETACH_LOG, dispatch [ready], fake rex/claude) and run-ship-change.txtar (fake gh for open-pr, ship check, merge); run-cleanup-steps.txtar for [[cleanup]]; workflow-invoke.txtar for installing a team skill under $HOME/.claude/skills. Spawn and step-start holds (run_spawn.go, engine.go StartHold), failed-run retry (daemon_watchdog.go watchdogTransient, FailedStep) and the intervention journal (internal/run/journal.go TypeIntervention) are not tied to built-in step names. Stall limits switch on step kind (watchdog_policy.go StallLimit): a gate step with no stall= gets the agent retry limit, not the command limit; the built-in gates set stall=70m, the BYO example workflow.toml gate sets none. Runaway detection (watchdog_runaway.go) cannot be triggered in a testscript (watchdogProcTable is nil under RHIZA_TEST_NOW), so it is covered by Go tests. cmd/rhiza/docs_examples_test.go already runs workflow check on docs/examples/byo/*.toml; a testscript cannot read repo files, so an archived copy needs a Go test holding it byte-identical to docs/examples/byo/workflow.toml.
